title: Extract cent rounding in pricing into one helper
body: apply_discount and with_tax in shop/pricing.py both convert Decimal back to int cents with the same quantize + ROUND_HALF_UP code. Extract it into one private helper _to_cents(value: Decimal) -> int. Behaviour must not change: existing tests must pass unchanged.

title: Document Inventory.release()
body: Inventory.release(sku, qty) has no docstring. Add one explaining what it does, what happens when qty is larger than what is reserved, and what it returns. Docs only, no behaviour change.

title: Add tests for apply_discount edge cases
body: tests/test_pricing.py does not cover apply_discount with 0 percent, 100 percent and a percent above 100 (which must raise ValueError). Add those tests only; do not change shop/pricing.py.

title: Spike: cost of multi-currency support
body: Spike, no code change: how much of shop/ assumes a single currency? List the places that would change to support EUR and JPY (JPY has no minor unit) and give a rough size (small/medium/large).

title: Cart.total() should include tax when a tax rate is set
body: Cart has no way to show a tax-inclusive total. Add an optional tax_rate (percent, int, default 0) to Cart and make total() apply pricing.with_tax when it is non-zero. Add tests.

title: Order history
body: Add order history to the shop: an Order model (id, lines, total cents, created_at), a store that appends orders to a JSON file and loads them back, Cart.checkout() that turns the cart into an Order and clears the cart, and a small CLI `python -m shop.orders list` that prints past orders. Every part needs tests.

title: Inventory.restock() accepts negative quantities
body: inv.restock('A', -5) silently lowers stock. Negative or zero qty must raise ValueError and leave stock unchanged. Run the tests with `make test`.
